Chapter 6462: Want To Fight?

Chapter 6462: Want To Fight?

“Crack!” Cracks appeared in both space and the ground with each step.

She entered Octagon as well - her ferocious storm a stark contrast to Rising Buddha’s golden kingdom inciting serenity. Everyone knew she could crush them with a single thought.

Octagon seemed to be on the verge of sinking due to their arrival. Insects could at least struggle but everyone else felt they were inferior to insects, more like specks of dust at this point.

“The golden spring.” Earthsplitter gazed at the liquid spewing from the small house.

Her voice was pleasant and soft, yet it ruptured some eardrums and made people faint. Her aura was far more intimidating than the Buddhist cultivator.

“Amitabha.” Rising placed his palms together and chanted, turning some of the water into golden lotuses. The area around Octagon became a land of peace.

The competition had started before an actual fight. Each displayed their mastery of the golden power.

Concerning actual cultivation, Earthsplitter had an absolute advantage. However, the golden power made up the difference in one way or another. It could be lifespan, karma, or anything else he so desired.

“Right before us yet so far away.” Rising used his heavenly gaze to see through the ground, speculating the exact location of the spring.

Finding the source wasn’t that easy or the primal ancestors would have found it long ago.

“The seal is here so it can’t be far.” Earthsplitter said.

“We split fifty-fifty?” Rising exchanged glances with her.

“You overestimate yourself.” Earthsplitter said: “One-third for you.”

“Don’t be unreasonable, Fellow Daoist.” Rising’s expression changed as he placed his palms together.

“What if I am?” Earthsplitter didn’t yield.

“Already talking about how to eat before catching the duck. You primal ancestors are funny.” Someone interrupted them.

Both stared at the speaker who turned out to be Li Qiye. One sent a storm while the other tried to purify him.

“Stop!” Goldblade and Virtuoso didn’t allow anyone to disrespect Li Qiye.

Alas, the gap was insurmountable between emperors and primal ancestors. Moreover, these were powerful primal ancestors.

“Bam!” The two staggered backward from just the gazes despite their best efforts.

This astounded the crowd since they couldn’t reach the apex level regardless of their perseverance. Alas, apex-level emperors were so helpless against primal ancestors.

“Want to fight, I see.” Li Qiye waved his hand and dispelled the gazes.

Golden power and primal energy did not affect Li Qiye. He wiped them away like spiderwebs.

The two primal ancestors finally became serious and paid more attention to this unknown man, aware of his power.

Strangely enough, he had no trace of golden power on him. In Gold Village, this type of power trumped all so its absence astounded them.

Other powers weren’t as effective here and relied on the golden power to be used properly. However, this man resembled a mortal.

“May I ask for your name, Fellow Daoist?” Rising asked respectfully.

“Just a passerby.” Li Qiye smiled.
